'''Staive Pedsten''' was a famous [[Grav-ball/Legends|zoneball]] athlete from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], near the [[Horn Estate]]. He was rumored to have once been romantically involved with [[Prince/Legends|princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].
